resources.string: Your system is up to date
Googlebook OS checks for a new release every day and installs it overnight while the tablet charges.
Googlebook OS %1$d (%2$s). The tablet prepares it on Wi-Fi while charging; your data is kept.
The new release is downloaded and adapted to this tablet. You can keep using it.

Googlebook OS %1$s will be installed tonight while the tablet charges, or now with a restart. Installing takes about ten minutes; your data is kept. If the new version does not start properly, the tablet returns to the current one by itself.
The tablet confirms that the new version runs well. If it does not, it returns to the previous version by itself.
Your system is up to date
The new version did not start properly, so the tablet returned to the previous version. Your data is as it was before the update.
The update service is not running.
The tablet restarts, installs Googlebook OS %1$s and starts again. This takes about ten minutes; don\'t turn it off.
Charge the tablet first: at least %1$d %%, or %2$d %% while charging.
Googlebook OS %1$d (%2$s) will be prepared on Wi-Fi while the tablet charges.
It will be installed tonight while the tablet charges.
The new version did not start properly; the tablet returned to the previous one.
